system.description:
Your phantasms now beguile every sense at once — a wall that looks solid, feels rough to the hand and smells of old dust and paint, yet parts like air when someone walks through it.

Expend one Willpower Trait and one Blood Trait and best your subjects in a Social Challenge (retest Subterfuge). The illusion may appeal to any senses you choose, and may even omit sensations as readily as add them, but still cannot move on its own or physically affect anyone. It endures under the same conditions as Ignis Fatuus — until you leave, until you dispel it, or until a subject disbelieves it.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
